{{Quote|I need you to convince the Senate, or the Jedi Council, or whoever is in charge of this terrible war, that we are threatened.|Queen Neeyutnee, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />}}
[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] '''Neeyutnee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who ruled as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] during the tumultuous [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Elected in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] as the successor to Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], the very young but mature Neeyutnee harbored no illusions about the war and met problems with appropriate action. She became closely involved with the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]], and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], ensuring that her peaceful [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] remained relatively unharmed by the war. Not long after ascending to the throne, Neeyutnee was faced with a subtle [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] incursion when a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] patrol was found in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]]. She worked swiftly with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to uncover the nature of the threat, and Amidala's investigations resulted in the discovery and [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|eradication]] of a [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|secret Separatist laboratory]] that had been recreating the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] on their [[Planet/Legends|world]].

When the Confederacy later sowed Gungan&ndash;[[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] tensions in an effort to [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|invade]] Naboo, Neeyutnee again worked with Amidala and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to avert the threat of invasion to their homeworld. Thanks to their combined efforts, the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was forced to recall his [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|battle droid army]] from Naboo, and Binks also restored the Gungans' alliance with Neeyutnee's regime. She later oversaw the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] in celebration of the 857th anniversary of Naboo's union with the Republic. Neeyutnee only served one term before stepping down as Naboo's monarch, and, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], she had been succeeded by Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]].

==Biography==
===Queen of Naboo===
{{Quote|Moving on: Boss Nass, you have a matter to bring forth to this council?''"<br />"''Wesa havin' grave, grave concerns, Queen Neeyutnee.|Neeyutnee and Rugor Nass, in a meeting of the Naboo Royal Advisory Council|<ref name="The Valley" />}}
[[File:PadmeNeeyutnee.png|thumb|left|250px|Neeyutnee worked closely with Senator Amidala to ensure Naboo's safety.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Neeyutnee,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> born in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] rule,<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Nurturing maturity from a young age, Neeyutnee became a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] skilled in [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] and leadership.<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Neeyutnee was elected<ref name="TCWCE" /> to succeed [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]],<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|queenneeyutnee|Neeyutnee, Queen}}</ref> becoming part of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]]. In spite of her very young age, Neeyutnee rose to the challenge of leading her [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] with the support of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]],<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /> the leader of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]].<ref name="DB Boss Nass">{{DB|character|bossnass|Nass, Boss}}</ref>

Neeyutnee led meetings of the Royal Advisory Council from the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in Naboo's capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Besides collaborating with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] of the Royal Security Forces and [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] of the Advisory Council in her duties,<ref name="The Valley" /> Neeyutnee worked closely with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who represented Naboo's peaceful views in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the Galactic Republic, to overcome threats from the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> In [[Time/Legends|times]] of crisis, Amidala would return home to advise Neeyutnee on the best course of action.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Neither Neeyutnee<ref name="TCWCE" /> nor Amidala underestimated the dangers posed by the Separatists,<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961f6f9ed7011f7098cb730005|text=Dataclip: Blue Shadow Virus|na=video file}}</ref> though they both faced the challenge and strain of leading their people in wartime.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" />

===The Trade Federation's revenge===
{{Quote|A droid scouting party like this can only mean one thing: ''invasion!"<br />"''Perhaps, Governor. But there still remains much we don't know. I have already taken the liberty to call back our Senate representative. If Naboo is troubled, Senator Amidala will doubtless do all in her power to see we get the aid we need.|Sio Bibble and Neeyutnee|<ref name="The Valley" />}}
Although Naboo was spared the worst of the Clone Wars,<ref name="CSWE Naboo">{{CSWECite|II|352-353|Naboo}}</ref> it was almost immediately after ascending to the throne that Neeyutnee was faced with a terrible threat on her homeworld.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> During an Advisory Council meeting, Rugor Nass brought to the queen's attention the [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] wrangler [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]], who reported that her shaak herd seemed quite worried and was acting restless in Naboo's [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]]. When Neeyutnee questioned whether there were problems with predators in the plains, Bow replied that this was not the case, and the Gungan herder also revealed that the last time her shaaks had been acting in such a strange matter had been a [[32 BBY/Legends|decade prior]], when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|battle droid army]] had [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo. Although both Sio Bibble and Security Forces [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Chrin]] were skeptical that something was amiss, Neeyutnee approved Captain Typho's decision to personally take out a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] as part of regular security patrols. Their vigilance paid off when Typho's men discovered and shot down a scouting party of Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] amidst Naboo's [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]]. After learning about the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from Typho,<ref name="The Valley" /> Neeyutnee ordered an immediate investigation and kept security forces on standby to counter further potential threats.<ref name="TCWCE" /> She also took the liberty of calling Amidala back home from the Senate's [[Senate Building/Legends|headquarters]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], hoping that she could convince the Senate to provide aid for the Naboo.<ref name="The Valley" />

Neeyutnee and Typho met with Amidala when she arrived at the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Palace Hangar]] in her [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|Nubian yacht]], accompanied by her [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and Naboo's [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Although Neeyutnee wanted Amidala to petition the Senate and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] for assistance in combating the threat to their world, Amidala knew that a few [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on Naboo would be not enough proof,<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> as the senator&mdash;then Queen of Naboo&mdash;had encountered a lack of response from the Senate when Naboo had been [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] and occupied by the Trade Federation previously.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Ep Guide" /> Once [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Nuvo Vindi)|one]] of the battle droids from the Separatist patrol, a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], was ready for analysis, Neeyutnee, Typho, Amidala, Binks, and C-3PO proceeded to<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> a droid repair room to see what could be recovered from the droid. Under their supervision, a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B medical droid]] performed a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] and examined the tactical droid's [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]],<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Ep Guide" /> though the captured droid was unintentionally reactivated, albeit without the use of its [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. Posing as a fellow battle droid, C-3PO convinced the tactical droid to recount its assignment on Naboo, one that, according to the tactical droid, concerned some sort of leaked virus and a secret [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on the world. Before the tactical droid could disclose any more information, Binks accidentally tipped over some shelves that then crushed the droid, ending the possibility of uncovering more of its data.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

[[File:Naboo_holo_conference.png|thumb|right|250px|Neeyutnee and her associates contact the Jedi Council for assistance.]]
Though the tactical droid was lost, Binks provided their first lead on the location of the secret laboratory when he stated that he had been chasing a [[Slug-beetle/Legends|slug-beetle]] from the captured droids. Slug-beetles only resided in the mud under [[Perlote tree/Legends|perlote trees]], which could be found in Naboo's eastern swamps,<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> the same place where Bow had encountered trouble with her shaaks.<ref name="The Valley" /> Because the droids were blotched with mud from an indeterminable location, Amidala realized that the laboratory was in the eastern swamps, from where the droids had brought the mud and the slug-beetle. Armed with this evidence of the Separatists' activity, Amidala, Neeyutnee, and the others went to contact the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] for help. Speaking with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] through a [[Hologram/Legends|holoconnection]] from the palace's communications center, the Naboo officials asked for aid in combating the threat to their home. At Amidala's request, Yoda consented to send [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Naboo because of their good relations with the Gungans.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

While Amidala had Typho and C-3PO analyze the rest of the captured battle droids, the senator took Binks to personally investigate the eastern swamps, despite Neeyutnee and Typho's concern for her safety. In a piece of memory from one of the B1 battle droids, Typho discovered that the Separatist-allied [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] was behind the threat to the Naboo people. Vindi intended to resurrect the [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] plague,<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> and he had received funding from the Trade Federation&mdash;specifically from [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who hoped to exact his revenge on Amidala and her people for the Federation's humiliating defeat during its occupation of Naboo.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> After Amidala found Vindi's [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|underground laboratory]], Kenobi, Skywalker, and the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were able to lead several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachments from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|shut down]] the facility before it could spread the Blue Shadow Virus to the galaxy.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] success came in part from Neeyutnee's early control of the situation.<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" />

===Separatist plots on Naboo===
{{Quote|Binks, yousa been bombad leader in my place. This a second time yousa stopping war between us and the Naboo.''"<br />"''And we are grateful, Senator Binks.''"<br />"''Mesa doing my best.|Lyonie, Neeyutnee, and Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 7">{{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}</ref> when Boss Nass later retired as the leader of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]],<ref name="Explore: Shadow Warrior">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep404|text="Shadow Warrior" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Neeyutnee began to work with Boss [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]], his successor as the leader of the Gungan High Council. As suffering and civil unrest began to grip the Naboo populace, another problem emerged for Neeyutnee when the war returned to her homeworld in the form of an impending Separatist invasion. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] conspired with the Gungan [[Minister/Legends|Minister]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] to re-open ages-old tensions between the Gungans and the Naboo, effectively bringing the Gungans on the side of the Confederacy against Neeyutnee's people. Influencing Boss Lyonie with mind-controlling [[Magic/Legends|magic]], Loo had Lyonie deliver fiery anti-Naboo rhetoric, calling for a [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] assault on Theed. When Neeyutnee and Typho received reports from the Royal Naboo Security Forces about the potential Gungan&ndash;Separatist march on the capital, Padmé Amidala returned to help quell the strained relations. Neeyutnee received Amidala when she landed in the Theed Palace [[Hangar/Legends|Hangar]] aboard an [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|''Eta''-class shuttle]] with Anakin Skywalker, and Amidala and Skywalker proceeded to the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] Gungan city of Otoh Gunga with Jar Jar Binks to meet with the strangely-acting Lyonie. Loo was subsequently exposed as the plot's perpetrator and was forced to flee from Otoh Gunga, while Binks was able to call off the Gungan Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] march on Theed.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

[[File:NeeyutneeLeaves-SW.png|thumb|left|250px|Neeyutnee and Lyonie, once again allies, thank Binks for his actions.]]
In spite of the exposure of Loo's exploits, the problem remained of the Separatists, who arrived on Naboo with a full [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] led by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Thanks to the [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|sacrifice]] of Gungan General [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]], the Gungans were able to capture the deadly Grievous, who was taken into joint custody by Neeyutnee and the Gungans. However, when Skywalker was taken captive by Dooku himself, Amidala and Neeyutnee were forced to exchange Grievous for the detained Jedi General. On the Naboo plains, with a trio of C-9979 [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] hovering overhead, Neeyutnee, Amidala, Binks, and a recovered Lyonie met with a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Naboo)/Legends|Confederate tactical droid]] to make the prisoner exchange. On Neeyutnee's order, Grievous's Gungan guards released the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] officer to the Separatists' waiting [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], while Skywalker was set free. Grievous and his fleet then departed from Naboo, their invasion plans thwarted. Despite losing Grievous, Neeyutnee and Lyonie were grateful, for an unnecessary conflict had been averted that day. Both Lyonie and Neeyutnee thanked Binks for his part in preventing another Naboo&ndash;Gungan clash, as he had done once before during the Invasion of Naboo over a decade prior.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

In celebration of the 857th anniversary of Naboo's allegiance to the Republic, the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] was to be held at Theed's Royal Palace. Among the many guests whom Neeyutnee and Padmé Amidala were to host was Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and none other than [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], himself a native of Naboo, who was to preside over the ceremony.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> Three days before the festival, however, the Republic's capture of criminal mastermind [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] revealed that a Separatist plot was in the works to kidnap the Chancellor during the festivities. Because Palpatine refused to abandon his role in the festival, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] undertook its own measures to [[Spy/Legends|infiltrate]] and hinder [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku's kidnapping plot,<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref> while security measures in Theed were increased: the Royal Naboo Security Forces stationed armed sentries at all of the entry points to the Royal Palace, a delegation of [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] was to oversee the festival stage where Palpatine would be speaking, and the stage itself was to be sealed off by a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] for the duration of the event. Furthermore, several Jedi were to serve as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] for Palpatine as well as Neeyutnee and her staff. On the day of the festival, amidst the busy preparations for that night, Neeyutnee, Amidala, Sio Bibble, and Bail Organa gathered at the Royal Palace's [[Theed Landing Plaza/Legends|Landing Plaza]] to await Palpatine's arrival. He landed there in a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] with Senate [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and their bodyguard personnel, consisting of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] and [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] from the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], as well as Mace Windu, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

Neeyutnee and Amidala greeted Palpatine as he disembarked from the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], though the Chancellor remained of the belief that the amount of security accompanying him was overkill. Skywalker assigned Tano to be the personal bodyguard for Neeyutnee, Amidala, and their staff with orders to get them to safety in case of trouble. Skywalker and Windu, meanwhile, would be personally overseeing the Senate Guards' security measures. Once everything was in place, the festival began that night, and Neeyutnee, Amidala, Bibble, and Organa were escorted onto the festival stage with Palpatine and Amedda as the ceremony began. They sat at one of the risers along the stage, amidst the large audience, while the program began with Palpatine's opening address. As part of his speech, Palpatine initiated the Festival of Light's [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]] show, which showcased the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan's]] discovery of Naboo to Theed's original development as a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] community. However, it was during the fireworks that Dooku's [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operatives launched their [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|plan]] to kidnap Palpatine. The [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]] compromised the stage's [[Ray shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], triggering an explosion that injured Palpatine. While Windu and Skywalker protected the Chancellor, Tano led Neeyutnee, Amidala, and their colleagues back into the Royal Palace to take cover. Although Dooku's [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters, led by the notorious mercenary [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], succeeded in capturing Palpatine, Skywalker and Windu managed to rescue him with the help of Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had gone undercover as the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] to infiltrate Dooku's plot.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

[[File:ThankYouJedi-Crisis.png|thumb|right|240px|Neeyutnee and Amidala thank the Jedi for rescuing Palpatine from Dooku's hunters.]]
The next morning, Neeyutnee, Amidala, and their staff went to the Republic's staging area to personally thank the Jedi for saving Palpatine. With the threat of Dooku's plot apparently averted, Palpatine ordered the Jedi security detail back to Coruscant so that only Skywalker would remain as his protection, as the Chancellor was to stay a day longer before returning to Coruscant as well. Neeyutnee held a banquet at the Theed Royal Palace that night, with Amidala among the attendees. Though Skywalker and Palpatine were also invited to the dinner, they were delayed when Dooku launched his true kidnapping attempt, his bounty hunters' earlier botched plot having only been a diversion. The Jedi managed to rescue Palpatine a second time, with Skywalker and Kenobi earning credit for the rescue.<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" /> As the war continued, Neeyutnee stepped down as Monarch of Naboo, only serving one term as Naboo's queen.<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Neeyutnee had been succeeded by Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]],<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /><ref name="Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> who led Naboo and its people through the [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|loss]] of Senator Amidala and the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="DB Apailana">{{DB|character|queenapailana|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> the Republic's authoritarian successor under the leadership of the newly christened [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We came as soon as we could, my lady. Have you found any more droids?''"<br />"''Only the three. But you can be sure they aren't tourists.|Padmé Amidala and Neeyutnee, who worked together to overcome Separatist threats|<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />}}
[[File:QueenNeeyutneeDetail-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Though young, Neeyutnee was capable of leading her people through the Clone Wars.]]
A skilled politician,<ref name="TCWCE" /> Queen Neeyutnee was dedicated to her people and cared for their well-being. She was willing to go to great lengths to keep Naboo safe.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Dataclip" /> Like many of her peers,<ref name="TCWCE" /> she saw the Clone Wars as terrible;<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> the war threatened many lives<ref name="TCWCE" /> and increased the difficulty of her leadership of Naboo.<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles" /> Even at a very young age,<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /> she was quite mature, and she did not harbor any illusions about the peril that the Confederacy of Independent Systems posed to her homeworld.<ref name="TCWCE" /> She maintained a calm outward demeanor in important situations, even when dealing with the Confederacy.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" /> She was careful in her questioning of Peppi Bow, making sure to garner all relevant information about her shaaks' abnormal behavior. Although Neeyutnee was initially hesitant to believe that battle droids were on Naboo, Gregar Typho eventually found such intruders on their world.<ref name="The Valley" /> 

Following Typho's discovery, Neeyutnee took appropriate action, immediately ordering an investigation and keeping security forces on standby to address potential threats.<ref name="TCWCE" /> She did not hesitate to recall Naboo's senator, Padmé Amidala, to assist in the search for information. Neeyutnee was not quick to jump to conclusions based on a lack of evidence: whereas Sio Bibble immediately assumed from the battle droids' presence that the Confederacy was planning an invasion of Naboo, she instead elected to wait for more information.<ref name="The Valley" />

Besides being knowledgeable in diplomacy, leadership, and legislative strategy,<ref name="TCWCE" /> Neeyutnee possessed wisdom in knowing which of her peers' advice to listen to, what action to take, and from whom to request assistance for certain matters. She rose to the challenge of leading her people in wartime thanks to the assistance of her Royal Advisory Council, the Royal Security Forces, and the Gungan leader Rugor Nass.<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /> In addition to maintaining close working relationships with Nass, Bibble, and Typho,<ref name="The Valley" /> Neeyutnee operated closely with Amidala, heavily relying on her to see Naboo through Separatist crises<ref name="TCWCE" /> and accepting her experience-based insight and counsel.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> After Amidala returned to Naboo, Neeyutnee demanded that she inform the Republic Senate of the danger posed to their world, but Amidala knew from experience that more concrete evidence than a few battle droids would be required for a petition for assistance.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> She placed her faith in the senator's abilities and dedication to her people, trusting that Amidala would do everything in her power to obtain the proper aid for Naboo.<ref name="The Valley" /> Neeyutnee's sagacious actions ultimately helped save her people from the Trade Federation's secret incursion.<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /> When the Confederacy mounted an invasion of Naboo that proved unsuccessful, Neeyutnee was thankful to Jar Jar Binks for his part in healing the Gungan&ndash;Naboo tensions that had been re-opened by the Separatist conspiracy.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

Fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|lavender]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black hair, Neeyutnee stood at 1.69 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (5 [[Foot/Legends|ft]], 7 in) tall.<ref name="TCWCE" /> In addition, she had purple facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]. Neeyutnee was able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and did so with a slight accent.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

==Skills and abilities==
Neeyutnee was talented in legislative strategy, diplomacy, and leadership.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Equipment==
Her wardrobe included a simple, dark robe made from [[Cyrene silk/Legends|Cyrene silk]] that was trimmed with purple, and she often sported similarly purple earrings. Her hair was frequently adorned with purple beads, as a mark of royalty.<ref name="TCWCE" /> She also wore a pair of earrings and hair beads.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" /> On her lower lip, she wore the [[Scar of remembrance/Legends|scar of remembrance]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> a symbolic reminder of Naboo's<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> prior to the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]].<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary" /> For self-defense, she carried a royal [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Databank" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayal===
[[File:NeeyutneeBibble.png|thumb|right|180px|Neeyutnee first appeared in ''The Valley'', which led into "Blue Shadow Virus."]]
Created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Ep Guide" /> the character of Queen Neeyutnee was first mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' in [[December]] [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE Neeyutnee">{{CSWECite|II|367|Neeyutnee, Queen}}</ref> She was first featured in "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]," the seventeenth episode in the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]],<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Ep Guide" /> and ''[[The Clone Wars: The Valley]]'', the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|webcomic]] that led into the episode. She was depicted in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] by artist [[Grant Gould]]<ref name="The Valley" /> and was portrayed in the episode by voice actress [[Jameelah McMillan]]. Both the episode and the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] were released in [[February]] [[2009]].<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus Ep Guide" />

Neeyutnee was given an entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]], though it erroneously stated that she appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[March]] [[2011]], Neeyutnee was featured in the non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', which humorously adapted "Blue Shadow Virus." She was given a brief cameo in the scene in which Typho and the others robolobotomize the captured tactical droid. Following the "Blue Shadow Virus" level, she was made available for use in the game's "Free Play" mode. Additionally, she was featured as one of the bounty hunter Cad Bane's [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hostages]] as part of the game's depiction of the episode "[[Hostage Crisis]]."<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

Although ''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'' stated that Neeyutnee did not carry any weapons,<ref name="TCWCE" /> her entry in the StarWars.com Databank maintained that she carried a royal [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol.<ref name="Databank" /> This article assumes that the latter is correct.

===The new queen===
{{Quote|Young Neeyutnee is the newly elected Queen of Naboo, succeeding Jamillia as the Clone Wars rage throughout the galaxy.|The beginning of the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia''{{'s}} entry for Queen Jamillia's revised successor, Neeyutnee|<ref name="TCWCE" />}}
Neeyutnee presented a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] to ''[[Star Wars]]'' canon's previously established lineage of Naboo monarchs. Queen Apailana was originally Queen Jamillia's successor<ref name="DB Apailana" /> until ''The Clone Wars'' inserted Neeyutnee's term between those of Jamillia and Apailana.<ref name="Official Starships Collection 62" /> However, there is still confusion surrounding this change, as not all sources published after "Blue Shadow Virus" have been consistent. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', for example, still makes use of the original line of monarchs in its entry for Naboo, despite the fact that it was co-authored by [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> who also wrote ''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1''.<ref name="OEG:S1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> Apailana's own entry in ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' even maintains the original lineage,<ref name="CSWE Apailana">{{CSWECite|I|37|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> despite the introduction of Neeyutnee as Jamillia's successor in the same publication.<ref name="CSWE Neeyutnee" /> This article attempts to respect both newer and older sources as best as possible until a cohesive timeline is established.

Initially, the novel ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'' ([[July]] [[2010]])&mdash;the events of which occurred in 21 BBY, per ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''<ref name="Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>&mdash;depicted Neeyutnee's predecessor, Queen Jamilia, as still in power during that year.<ref name="Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref> Neeyutnee was shown to have succeeded Jamilia by the time of the episode "Blue Shadow Virus," whose events were placed in 21 BBY by ''The Official Episode Guide: Season 1'' ([[October]] 2009),<ref name="OEG:S1" /> indicating that Neeyutnee was elected as Monarch of Naboo in 21 BBY. However, that date of succession was overridden by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' (October 2012), which placed the majority of the first season's events<ref name="ERC" />&mdash;including those of "Blue Shadow Virus"<ref name="Chronicling TCW 5">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-5|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #5|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref>&mdash;in 22 BBY.<ref name="ERC" /> Based on current source material, it is assumed that Neeyutnee was elected in 22 BBY.
